description: This file defines Flutter widgets for UI animations, specifically a fade-in effect with delay and a pulsing glow effect.

classes.name: DelayedFadeIn
classes.description: A widget that adds a delayed fade-in animation to its child.

classes.name: _DelayedFadeInState
classes.description: State class managing the fade-in animation for DelayedFadeIn widget.

classes.name: PulseGlow
classes.description: A widget that adds a pulsing glow effect around its child.

classes.name: _PulseGlowState
classes.description: State class managing the pulsing glow animation for PulseGlow widget.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the animation controllers and starts the fade-in delay timer.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the animated widget.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the animation controllers to free resources.
